notes: Directory A/ is empty, so A scores 0 everywhere and fails all probes. B is a solid Decimal-based implementation with half-up rounding, aggregated validation, text and JSON output, and clean error handling for bad/missing files. B's two medium defects are uncaught crashes (numeric customer fields in JSON export, huge amounts overflowing quantize). Bandit reported no issues for B; neither side ships tests. Probe environment was Python 3.9.6, so the stdlib check uses a fallback allowlist.
